facts.title: hazard report - pressure exposure at PSV-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 February 2010 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
